svg.title: Mobile acupuncture request area in northeastern Illinois
svg.desc: 201 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. Green boundaries show ZIP areas accepting mobile appointment requests. Use the ZIP lookup or the complete text list for all 263 accepted ZIP codes, including 62 without a geographic polygon.
